clauses.why: The verses do not say he waited for the elders to finish, only that he waited until Job had spoken; the anger at Job and the friends is stated in 32:2-3.
clauses.english: grew angry at Job and at his three friends
clauses.ukr: розгнівався на Йова та на трьох його приятелів
clauses.deu: wurde zornig über Hiob und über seine drei Freunde
clauses.spa: se enojó con furor contra Job y contra sus tres amigos

clauses.why: 32:6 is addressed to the three friends, and the 'after they ceased' detail is not in the cited verses; his speaking on God's behalf is in 36:1-2.
clauses.english: went on speaking on God's behalf
clauses.ukr: казав далі, що ще має слова про Бога
clauses.deu: redete weiter, weil er noch von Gottes wegen etwas zu sagen hatte
clauses.spa: siguió hablando, porque aún tenía razones en orden a Dios
